error.unexpectedClientError: Kuskuren abokin ciniki da ba a zata ba.
error.androidSystemScreenTitle: Buɗe manhajar da za a gwada

guide.title: Yadda ake amfani da LumaTrace
guide.subtitle: Zaɓi Windows ko Android, bi matakan dandalin, fara gwaji, sannan dakatar ka karanta rahoto.
guide.mockBody: Mock Local Device na'urar nuni ce da aka gina a ciki. Manufofinta suna samar da ma'aunan mock da aka yi wa alama a sarari domin ka koyi hanyar aiki ba tare da haɗa kayan aiki ba.
guide.pcBody: Local PC yana jera ainihin tsarukan Windows. Zaɓi manufa guda don tattara CPU da ƙwaƙwalwa. FPS yana buƙatar bayyanannen rikodin PresentMon.
guide.androidBody: A wayar, kunna zaɓuɓɓukan Mai Haɓakawa da gyaran kuskure ta USB, ba wannan PC izini, buɗe manhajar da kake son gwadawa, sannan zaɓe ta a nan ka fara zaman gwaji.
guide.deviceConcept: Na'ura: tushen da ake tattara bayanai daga gare shi, kamar wannan PC ko wayar Android.
guide.targetConcept: Manufa: manhaja, wasa ko tsarin da kake son aunawa a wannan na'urar.
guide.sessionConcept: Zaman gwaji: zagaye ɗaya na aunawa. Fara shi, kalli ma'aunai, dakatar da shi, sannan buɗe rahoto.
support.title: Gyara / Bayar da Rahoton Kuskure
support.body: Da farko gwada sake kunnawa mai aminci da sake duba kayan aiki. Idan matsalar ta ci gaba, buɗe fom ɗin kuskure na GitHub da aka shirya.
support.repairDescription: Sake kunna tattara bayanai na gida kuma a sake duba na'urori da kayan aiki.
support.repairingHelp: Ana sake kunna tattara bayanai na gida da sake duba kayan aiki da na'urori.
support.repairSuccess: An kammala gyara. An sabunta matsayin kayan aiki da na'ura.
support.repairFailed: Gyara ta atomatik bai kammala ba. Za ka iya bayar da rahoton kuskure don a biyo baya.
support.submitDescription: Buɗe fom ɗin kuskure na GitHub da aka shirya da dannawa ɗaya.
support.submitFailed: Ba a iya buɗe shafin kuskure na GitHub ba.
support.include: Bayanai masu amfani: sigar manhaja, sigar Windows/Android, samfurin na'ura, abin da ka danna, abin da ka yi tsammani, abin da ya faru, hotunan allo, da fitarwar bincike da aka tsaftace.
support.privacy: Kada a haɗa tokens, asusu, cikakkun hanyoyin gida, ɗanyen rajista, ɗanyen fayilolin CSV, logcat, bugreport ko hotunan allo na sirri.
device.mockDescription: Bayanan koyarwa masu aminci. Ma'aunan na ƙirƙira ne kuma an yi musu alama a sarari a matsayin mock.
device.localPcDescription: Gano ainihin tsarukan Windows da ɗaukar samfurin CPU/ƙwaƙwalwa.
session.beginnerTitle: Gudanarwa na farko da aka ba da shawara
session.beginnerBody: A gwajinka na farko, zaɓi Windows, zaɓi tsarin manhaja da ke aiki, danna Fara Gwaji, dakatar bayan ƴan daƙiƙu, sannan buɗe rahoto.
session.platformSubtitle: Fara daga dandalin da kake son gwadawa. LumaTrace zai jagorance ka zuwa mataki na gaba kuma ya bar ma'aunan da ba su samuwa a matsayin N/A.
session.platformWindowsBody: Zaɓi tsarin manhaja ko wasa a wannan PC, sannan fara gwaji. Idan tsarin ya fita, zaman gwajin zai tsaya ko ya rubuta bayyanannen katsewa.
session.platformAndroidBody: Kunna zaɓuɓɓukan Mai Haɓakawa da gyaran kuskure ta USB a wayar, ba wannan PC izini, buɗe manhajar da kake son gwadawa, sannan danna Fara Gwaji. LumaTrace yana gano fakitin manhajar gaba ta atomatik.
session.targetTitle: Zaɓi abin da za a gwada
session.targetHelp: Tsoffin saituna masu aminci sun shirya.
session.runningHelp: Yi amfani da manhajar yadda aka saba. Kammala gwajin idan ka ɗauki yanayin da kake son aunawa.
session.defaultStep2: Bi umarnin haɗi ko zaɓin manhaja na wannan dandalin.
session.defaultStep3: Fara gwajin bayan an zaɓi na'ura da manufa.
session.choosePlatformFirstBody: Bayan ka zaɓi Windows ko Android, wannan yanki zai nuna na'ura, manufa da aikin farawa na dandalin kawai.
session.windowsStep3: Danna Fara Gwaji. CPU, ƙwaƙwalwa, FPS da lokacin firam suna sabuntawa kai tsaye idan PresentMon yana samuwa; in ba haka ba FPS zai kasance N/A.
session.androidStep1: A wayar Android, kunna zaɓuɓɓukan Mai Haɓakawa, kunna gyaran kuskure ta USB, haɗa kebul na USB, sannan ba wannan PC izini.
session.androidStep2: Buɗe manhajar da kake son gwadawa a wayar.
session.androidStep3: Danna Fara Gwaji. LumaTrace yana gano fakitin manhajar gaba ta wayar ta atomatik.
session.mockHint: Manufofin mock don koyon hanyar aiki ne kawai. Ba ainihin ma'aunan na'ura ko manhaja ba ne.
session.noPlatformDevice: Babu na'ura ga wannan dandalin tukuna.
session.androidForegroundTitle: Manhajar da ke buɗe a wayar yanzu
session.androidForegroundPending: Buɗe manhajar a wayar, sannan danna Fara Gwaji. Sunan fakiti zai bayyana a nan bayan an gano shi.
session.windowsVisibleAppsHelp: Ana nuna manhajojin da suke buɗe da farko. Bincike yana kuma gano tsarukan bango.
session.noWindowsTargetMatches: Babu tsarin Windows da ya dace da wannan binciken. Gwada wani suna ko sabunta manufofi.
session.exportLogsToReportDir: Ajiye rajista a babban fayil ɗin rahoto
session.exportLogsToReportDirHelp: Android yana adana ADB logcat da aka tsaftace na lokacin gwaji. Windows yana adana bayanan zaman LumaTrace masu hatimin lokaci.
session.noWindowsTargets: Ba a sami tsarin manhajar Windows da ke aiki ba tukuna. Buɗe manhaja ko wasan da kake son gwadawa, sannan sabunta jerin manufofi.
session.noAndroidTargets: Babu manufa ta manhajar Android tukuna. Kunna zaɓuɓɓukan Mai Haɓakawa da gyaran kuskure ta USB, ba wannan PC izini, buɗe manhajar a wayar, sannan sabunta.
device.title: Bayanan Na'ura
device.subtitle: Manufofi da samuwar ma'aunai na na'urar local-server da aka zaɓa.
device.androidHelp: Android Beta tana buƙatar zaɓuɓɓukan Mai Haɓakawa da izinin gyaran kuskure ta USB. Tana goyon bayan sarrafa Fara Manhaja / Dakatar da Manhaja, binciken sake ɗaure tsari, da matsayin cache/lafiya da aka tsaftace. Samfurin CPU, ƙwaƙwalwa, baturi da hanyar sadarwa yana buƙatar adb. FPS har yanzu na gwaji ne.
device.pcHelp: PC Beta yana jera tsarukan Windows na gida kuma yana iya ɗaukar samfurin CPU da ƙwaƙwalwa da aka ɗaure da PID. FPS da lokacin firam suna buƙatar PresentMon kuma har yanzu na gwaji ne; ana ɓoye hanyoyin fayilolin aiwatarwa kafin nunawa.
device.forceStopConfirm: Wannan zai tilasta dakatar da fakitin manufa a na'urar.
device.cacheRefreshed: An sabunta cache na na'urar Android da mai ƙaddamarwa.
device.loadingCapabilities: Ana loda abubuwan da ake iya yi...
session.title: Zaman Gwaji
session.subtitle: Zaɓi dandali, zaɓi manhaja ko tsarin manufa, fara tattara bayanai, sannan dakatar ka karanta rahoto.
session.deviceNetworkNotice: Ƙididdigar hanyar sadarwa ta na'ura na iya haɗa zirga-zirgar wasu manhajoji.
session.uidNetworkNotice: An kiyasta ƙididdigar hanyar sadarwa ta UID daga dumpsys netstats detail.
session.androidNetworkNotice: Hanyar sadarwar Android tana amfani da netstats na UID idan suna samuwa, sannan ta koma ƙididdigar na'ura tare da bayyana daidaito.
session.androidFpsNotice: FPS/lokacin firam na Android na gwaji ne kuma ana gwada shi yayin gwaji da ƙididdigar firam na ADB na jama'a. Idan Android bai fitar da bayanan firam da suka dace ba, zai kasance N/A.
session.pcNotice: Gwajin Windows yana ƙoƙarin samun FPS/lokacin firam na PresentMon kai tsaye idan PresentMon yana samuwa. CPU da ƙwaƙwalwa za su ci gaba da aiki idan PresentMon babu. Samuwar PresentMon: {availability}.
session.restoreTitle: Mayar da Zaman Gwaji na Ƙarshe
session.lastKnownStatus: Matsayi na ƙarshe da aka sani
session.restoreLast: Mayar da zaman gwaji na ƙarshe
session.sampleIntervalHelp: Ƙananan lambobi suna tattarawa sau da yawa kuma suna sa lanƙwasa ya zama kamar kai tsaye, amma suna amfani da ƙarin CPU. Manyan lambobi sun fi sauƙi kuma sun fi kyau ga dogon gwaji, amma lanƙwasa ba ya da cikakkun bayanai. 100 ms tsoho ne mai kyau.
session.reportOutputDir: Babban Fayil ɗin Fitar da Rahoto
session.reportOutputDirHelp: Zaɓi inda za a adana rahotannin gwaji. Bayan gwaji ya ƙare, LumaTrace yana rubuta rahotannin HTML, JSON da CSV a wannan babban fayil.
session.reportOutputDirUnavailable: Yana samuwa bayan sabar gida ta bayar da rahoton babban fayil.
session.reportOutputDirChanged: An sabunta babban fayil ɗin rahoto. An sake kunna sabar gida cikin aminci.
session.reportOutputDirChangeFailed: Ba a iya saita babban fayil ɗin rahoto ba.
session.reportOutputDirOpened: An buɗe babban fayil ɗin rahoto.
session.reportOutputDirOpenFailed: Ba a iya buɗe babban fayil ɗin rahoto ba.
session.simpleSettingsHelp: Duk sauran saitunan gwaji suna amfani da tsoffin saituna masu aminci. Ma'aunan da suka ɓace suna kasancewa N/A kuma ba a cika su da 0 ba.
session.autoStartHelp: Fara Manhaja kafin zaman gwaji idan PID ya ɓace
session.monkeyFallbackHelp: Yi amfani da monkey -p package 1 kawai idan gano mai ƙaddamarwa ya gaza
session.stopTarget: Dakatar da manufa idan zaman gwaji ya tsaya
session.stopTargetHelp: Tilasta dakatar da fakitin manufa bayan zaman gwaji ya tsaya
session.experimentalFpsHelp: Kunna binciken FPS na gwaji a lokacin dakatarwa
session.presentMonEnableHelp: Gudanar da bayyanannen rikodin CSV mai lokaci don FPS/lokacin firam
session.presentMonKeepCsvHelp: Riƙe CSV na wucin gadi har sai an tsaftace zaman gwaji don gyaran kuskure na gida
session.androidFpsNaNotice: FPS da lokacin firam za su kasance N/A sai dai binciken gwaji ya samar da ma'aunan da suka dace da manufa. Ba a juya yadudduka masu ruɗani ko waɗanda suka ɓace zuwa FPS.
session.pcCaptureNotice: LumaTrace ba ya fara ko dakatar da tsarin da aka zaɓa. Rikodin PresentMon na gwaji ne. Rashin layukan PresentMon da suka dace yana nufin FPS zai kasance N/A.
session.autoStopped: Manhajar manufa ta ƙare, don haka an kammala gwajin ta atomatik kuma an adana rahotonsa na ɓangare.
session.restoreMissing: Sabar gida ba ta iya tabbatar da zaman gwaji na ƙarshe ba.
session.waitingForMetricsMessage: Ana haɗawa da manufa kuma ana jiran ainihin aunawa na farko. Zane-zane za su bayyana ta atomatik idan bayanai sun iso.
session.stopDialogMessage: Dakatarwa tana kammala ma'aunai kuma tana samar da rahoto. Ba za ta share tarihin gida ba.
session.createDialogMessage: Akwai zaman gwaji da ke gudana. Dakatar da shi kafin sauyawa domin tattara bayanai ya kasance bayyananne.
report.title: Sakamakon Gwaji
report.subtitle: Zaɓi sakamakon gwaji don ganin FPS, 1% Low, lokacin firam, CPU, ƙwaƙwalwa da rahotannin da aka fitar.
report.deleteOneMessage: A share {name} da bayanan gida da aka tattara? Za a riƙe fayilolin rahoton da aka fitar.
report.deleteAllMessage: A share sakamakon gwaji na gida {count} da aka kammala da bayanansu? Za a riƙe gwajin da ke gudana da fayilolin rahoton da aka fitar.
report.recentResultsHelp: Zaɓi gwajin da aka kammala ko aka katse don ganin rahotonsa.
report.noResultsMessage: Da farko gudanar da gwajin Windows ko Android. Rahoton zai bayyana a nan bayan ka dakatar da gwajin.
report.emptyEyebrow: A shirye don sakamakonka na farko
report.collectedSummary: an tattara ma'aunai {available} · ba a tattara {unavailable} ba
report.coreMetricsHelp: Ƙimomin da suka ɓace suna kasancewa N/A kuma ba a cika su da 0 ba.
report.performanceGroupHelp: Fara a nan: FPS yana nuna santsi, yayin da 1% Low da lokacin firam ke nuna kwanciyar hankali.
report.resourcesGroupHelp: CPU, GPU da ƙwaƙwalwar da aka yi amfani da su yayin gwajin wannan manhaja ko tsari.
report.deviceGroupHelp: Wuta, zafin GPU, baturi da bayanan hanyar sadarwa da dandalin ya tattara.
report.performancePoor: Matsakaicin FPS shi ne {avg}, ƙasa da 30 FPS. Aikin ba shi da kyau kuma ana iya ganin tsallaken firam.
report.performanceFair: Matsakaicin FPS shi ne {avg}, tsakanin 30 da 59.9 FPS. Aikin abin karɓa ne, amma wurare masu nauyi na iya zama marasa santsi.
report.performanceGood: Matsakaicin FPS shi ne {avg}, 60 FPS ko sama da haka. Aikin yana da kyau kuma ƙwarewar za ta kasance mai santsi gaba ɗaya.
report.performanceUnavailable: Ba a tattara matsakaicin FPS ba, don haka wannan rahoton ba zai iya kimanta aikin nunawa ba.
report.stabilityGood: 1% Low shi ne {onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% na matsakaici), wanda ke nuna isar firam mai kwanciyar hankali gaba ɗaya.
report.stabilityNeedsAttention: 1% Low shi ne {onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% na matsakaici), wanda ke nuna canjin saurin firam da ake iya lura da shi.
report.stabilityUnavailable: Babu isassun bayanan 1% Low don tantance kwanciyar hankalin saurin firam.
report.performanceThresholdNote: Waɗannan matakan FPS jagora ne na gaba ɗaya. Iyakar saurin firam, saurin sabunta allo, saitunan gani da yanayin gwaji na iya canja fassarar.
report.rawPreview: Gajerun rahotanni suna amfani da ɗanyen samfuran ma'auni don samfotin zane.
report.downsampledPreview: Dogayen rahotanni suna amfani da matsakaicin rukuni don samfotin zane. Ɗanyen fitarwa ba ya canjawa.
report.noTrendDataMessage: Zane-zanen FPS, lokacin firam, CPU da ƙwaƙwalwa suna kasancewa N/A idan babu samfuran lambobi.
report.exportHelp: Wannan gwajin ya ɗauki {duration}. Akwai ɗanyen samfuran ma'auni {metrics} don fitarwa.
report.noSession: Ba a zaɓi zaman gwaji ba
report.noPresentMonMessage: FPS da lokacin firam suna kasancewa N/A idan an kashe rikodi, ya ɓace, bai dace ba ko yana da ruɗani.
report.presentMonNotice: Rikodin PresentMon bayyananne ne kuma na gwaji. Rahotanni ba sa haɗa ɗanyen abun cikin CSV ko cikakkun hanyoyin fitarwa na gida.
report.diagnosticsNotice: An tsaftace fitarwa kuma ba ta haɗa fitowar logcat ko bugreport ba.
report.exportFailed: Ba a iya fitar da rahoton {format} ba.

tools.toolAction.presentMonAvailable: Kunna PresentMon kawai idan ana buƙatar bayanan FPS ko lokacin firam na Windows.
tools.toolAction.presentMonInstall: Shigar da PresentMon ko saita hanyar gida don kunna rikodin FPS na Windows.
tools.toolAction.checkConfiguration: Duba shigarwar kayan aiki da saitin gida.

tools.presentMonDefaultReason: Rikodin PresentMon bayyananne ne kuma na gwaji.

tools.presentMonLimit.noMatch: FPS yana kasancewa N/A idan ba a iya daidaita manufa guda ɗaya ba.

tools.presentMonLimit.other: PresentMon ya bayar da ƙarin iyakar dacewa.
tools.noDiagnosticsMessage: Kurakurai da matsalolin masu tattara bayanai za su bayyana a nan.
packaging.statusUnavailableMessage: Yanayin ci gaba zai iya ci gaba da amfani da pnpm dev:server.
packaging.checklist: Jerin Duban QA na Shirya Fakiti
packaging.check1: Local-server da aka shirya a fakiti yana ɗaure da 127.0.0.1 kawai.
packaging.check2: Ana buƙatar Bearer token don REST da WebSocket na fakiti.
packaging.check3: Ba a adana token a VITE variables, localStorage, URLs, rajista, rahotanni ko bincike.
packaging.check4: Sake kunna Sidecar yana da iyaka kuma an tsaftace binciken faɗuwa.
packaging.check5: An kunna juyawar rajista ga rajistan manhaja da sidecar.
packaging.check6: Gwajin hayaƙi na ma'ajiya a fakiti yana tabbatar da sake amfani da DB bayan sake kunnawa.
packaging.check7: Ana samar da manifests na sanarwar fakiti kuma har yanzu suna buƙatar bitar fitarwa.
packaging.check8: Shirye-shiryen fitar da fakitin Windows yana nan a toshe har sai an kammala ƙofofin samarwa.
packaging.check9: Ba a saita sa hannun samarwa, mai sabuntawa, notarization da rarrabawar shago ba.
packaging.rcNotice: Wannan taƙaitawa tana haɗa shirye-shiryen sidecar, QA na GUI da hannu, manufar fitarwa da shaidar ƙofar RC a gani ɗaya da aka tsaftace. Ba amincewar fitarwa ba ce, kuma productionReady yana kasancewa false.
packaging.notSelfContained: ba mai cin gashin kansa ba

presentMon.permissionsBody: FPS na kai tsaye yana buƙatar samun damar bin aikin Windows sau ɗaya. LumaTrace kansa yana ci gaba da aiki ba tare da izinin mai gudanarwa ba, kuma CPU/ƙwaƙwalwa suna nan ba tare da damar FPS ba.
session.fpsAccessBody: CPU da ƙwaƙwalwa suna aiki yanzu. Kunna bin aikin Windows sau ɗaya don ƙara FPS da lokacin firam.
session.fpsAccessRestartBody: Fita daga Windows sannan ka sake shiga sau ɗaya. Gwaje-gwaje na gaba za su gudana ba tare da damar mai gudanarwa ba.
session.fpsAccessErrorBody: CPU da ƙwaƙwalwa suna nan. Gwada sake dubawa.
session.fpsAccessCancelledBody: Babu abin da ya canja. Ci gaba da CPU da ƙwaƙwalwa, ko kunna FPS daga baya.
presentMon.retentionBody: Rahotanni ba sa haɗa ɗanyen abun cikin PresentMon CSV. Ana tsaftace hanyoyin gida kafin su bayyana a bincike ko rahotanni.
presentMon.noStatusBody: Ƙirƙira ko fara gwajin Windows don ganin matsayin rikodi.
presentMon.defaultReason: Rikodin PresentMon bayyananne ne kuma na gwaji. Ana fitar da FPS ne kawai bayan an daidaita manufa cikin nasara.
pc.sourcePrecision: FPS da lokacin firam na Windows suna zuwa daga bayyanannen rikodin PresentMon CSV kuma har yanzu na gwaji ne. CPU da ƙwaƙwalwa suna ci gaba idan PresentMon ya ɓace ko bai dawo da bayanai ba.

android.fpsExperimental: Gano FPS na Android na gwaji ne.
